name: bot_duel_refused_orders
description: The plan bot (tests/bot.gd) in a duel when its orders are refused (M7; contract-m7 §2 and §3). A cork its policy wants that is refused before it goes out (short of gold) or goes nowhere (the sequencer takes no order, as a full command bucket's Not so fast online) is not a played window: played_window stays where it was, so the flow bot's --ready-calls still wait, the plan does not spend, and the cork goes at the next step. An UNCORK of the bot's the simulation refuses (here one spoiled before its turn: BAD_REVEAL) is not one the bot took: left to the client, whose own uncorking at 24 s reveals the salt, the bot says the bottle was uncorked by the client, not by the bot (tools/net/smoke.py --mode undertow counts only the bot's own); stepping on, the bot sends it again once Game's retry wait has passed, long before 24 s, and that one is its own.

steps.assert: due and Game.state == Game.State.PREP and bot.corks_sent == 0 and bot.played_window < Game.wave + 1
steps.msg: in the window both hollows share, a cork is due

steps.assert: bot.corks_sent == 0 and bot.played_window < Game.wave + 1 and bot.done == done_before and scene.settled()
steps.msg: refused before it goes out (short of gold): the window is not played, and the plan has not spent

steps.assert: bot.corks_sent == 0 and bot.played_window < Game.wave + 1 and bot.done == done_before
steps.msg: a cork that goes nowhere: not played either, and the plan has not spent

steps.assert: bot.corks_sent == 1 and Game.sim.bottles(1).size() == 1 and bot.played_window == Game.wave + 1 and Game.state == Game.State.PREP
steps.msg: the cork goes at the next step, the bottle stands, and the window is played

steps.wait_until: Game.state == Game.State.WAVE and Game.sim.uncork_tick() >= 0 and Game.sim.tick >= Game.sim.uncork_tick()

steps.msg: from uncork_after_t the bot uncorks; its UNCORK is spoiled before its turn
the simulation refused the bot's, and the client's own uncorking at 24 s revealed the salt

steps.assert: bot.log.has('bottle %d window %d uncorked %s by client' % [first['id'], first['window'], first['pack']])
steps.msg: the bot says the client uncorked it

steps.assert: not bot.log.has('bottle %d window %d uncorked %s by bot' % [first['id'], first['window'], first['pack']])

steps.msg: a second bottle stands in a later window, not uncorked yet

steps.wait_until: Game.state == Game.State.WAVE and Game.sim.uncork_tick() >= 0 and Game.sim.tick >= Game.sim.uncork_tick()

steps.msg: the bot uncorks it; that UNCORK is spoiled too
stepping on, the bot uncorked it again after the retry wait, long before the client's own at 24 s
its second UNCORK for that bottle went out through the turns

steps.assert: bot.log.has('bottle %d window %d uncorked %s by bot' % [second['id'], second['window'], second['pack']])
steps.msg: and the bot says it uncorked it itself
